Cases with `silent: true` must return no brief when hooks run (no force). Tour examples from tools/tour.mjs join this corpus at run time. Play cases: `play` names the play the brief must return; `noPlay: true` forbids any play; `allowEmpty: true` accepts a brief with no command (filler-word cases).
